subject.title: refactor(config): config-surface reduction tranche 3 — product consolidations (review request)

question: Should OpenClaw permanently retire configured commitments, custom marketplace feeds, and non-default system-agent rescue behavior, accepting that upgrades remove those user-selected controls?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes operator-visible product capabilities rather than only relocating equivalent configuration, and the repository policy requires explicit judgment for compatibility-sensitive fallback and configuration removals.

options.title: Approve the retirements with upgrade proof
options.body: Accept the reduced product surface after a maintainer records the intended support boundary and the PR proves doctor migrations and the resulting behavior for existing configurations.

options.title: Retain the supported controls
options.body: Keep the relevant configuration contracts and move only duplicate ownership into canonical paths until a separate deprecation decision is made.

options.title: Split the disputed removals
options.body: Land only the uncontroversial consolidations and move commitments, marketplace feeds, and rescue-policy retirement into separately sponsored proposals.

recommendation.title: Approve the retirements with upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Accept the reduced product surface after a maintainer records the intended support boundary and the PR proves doctor migrations and the resulting behavior for existing configurations.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the consolidation series and explicitly framed the unresolved product choices for review.
